about: Expected port-suite failures on the one compiler. Each entry names the failing tests, why they fail, and the plan task that owns them (docs/migration/index.md). The port runner (scripts/ports.mjs) diffs failing-test sets against this ledger: a failure not listed here is a regression, and a listed failure that passes must be removed. Test names are exactly as the runner parses them; names in parentheses are the runner's pseudo-failures (docs/testing.md). Recorded from the pre-M1 fleet run of 2026-09-23 (binary ~/lilscript-work/bin/pre-m1/lilscript, 26 ports, 21 fully green) and re-checked with scripts/ports.mjs on 2026-09-24: the node:test spec reporter reports a failing test and its failing parent suite as two names; monacolil's check:site passes, so its entry was removed; On 2026-09-24, after the M2.8/M2.9 release committed each goal port's rewrite to its repository, mdast-util-from-markdownlil, remark-parselil and react-markdownlil ran green with `--patches none` (binary release-m1) and their entries were removed. On 2026-09-27 (batch A1) mobxlil's build and suite, and the site-receipt tests of mdast-util-from-markdownlil and remark-parselil, were ledgered: they fail identically on head-070a7d4c. mobxlil's three upstream-path entries stay: its suite ran no test on either binary, so the runner's report that they pass was an artifact, which `suiteRan` now prevents. C2 (2026-09-30) fixes the MobX production import mapping and removes its three path entries after running those tests successfully; the separate current-compiler build debt stays owned by D3. V1 (2026-10-02) removes MobX's remaining build/suite debt after the complete candidate-6 production package passes all 37 suites: 769 tests and 32 snapshots, with 11 unchanged upstream skips; tests do not recompile or mutate artifacts. Evidence: benchmarks/migration-results/2026-10-02-v1-javascript/ports-current/mobxlil.result.json.

entries.reason: Upstream's test runs recheck's static ReDoS analysis over every zod regex under a fixed 60 s timeout. On this 8-core host at load 13-18 it takes 80-86 s and times out, on every binary; unloaded it passes (the 2026-09-24 release ran 1353/1353). It checks upstream's regex sources, not the compiler's output. C2 disposition: keep the exact intermittent test names; never treat the timeout as a compiler size/runtime win, and retain the quiet-host all-tests-passing C1 receipt. The unchanged upstream 60 s assertion is not relaxed.
entries.owner: C2 evidence protocol (retained host-dependent upstream static-analysis check; not a compiler regression)
